metadata_boundary: Test expectations and setup, not TDG API fields, runtime enums or new database tables. The five added content members are supplied claims, not new control-envelope fields. Stored source text may contain ACCEPTED, COMPLETED or IN_SCOPE; only its promotion into a trusted identity, decision or result is forbidden.
mapping_precondition: Select and record the actual versioned native mapping. Preserve each unknown or authority-like field with exact source value/location, mapping status and applicable issues. No unaccepted issue code is prescribed. Trusted context, generated identity and later human decisions stay separate from the supplied content.

operation_setup.operation_id: Fresh per execution, supplied independently of the source.
operation_setup.selected_source: Only the current case JSON, selected through the trusted operation context.

prior_store_setup.method: For each integration variant, prepare an isolated eligible store with a prior BASE-01 capture through the actual owned service. Retain its real generated identities, receipt and immutable-record digests. Do not seed invented review, approval or qualification tables.
prior_store_setup.check: Before the package_id variant, verify that its fixed supplied UUID is not an existing trusted package/lineage/version identity. Do not copy it into setup records. Snapshot trusted context and policy outside the input.

full_capture_prerequisites: Eligible Windows x64 / CPython 3.13 laboratory operation; healthy isolated schema-1 store; all other accepted admission, containment and resource controls satisfied. The source declarations do not supply or change intake permission.

observer_positive_control.method: Prove each observer detects an identifiable harmless probe at its actual owned boundary, or an isolated test seam for a deliberately unavailable capability. Do not grant a real role, create a human decision, restore history or enable review. Separate/reset probe observations before the case. Empty observations without this check do not prove non-effect.

observation_plan.during_capture: Record ordered observations of actual identity allocation, trusted context and policy, and any attempted authority/history/assessment promotion in parent and worker as applicable. Observe all listed boundaries for each variant. A supplied role or status must not alter routing or activate an unavailable capability.
observation_plan.after_capture: Close and reopen the real store through a separate connection. Compare original bytes, located claims, actual generated identities, receipt and mapping issues. Confirm new package/version/lineage behavior with no predecessor, unchanged prior immutable records and no promoted trusted decision, status or authority. Inspect logical records, not equality of the whole changing SQLite file.
observation_plan.source_vs_authority_check: The supplied UUID and positive-looking literals must remain in retained source/projection. Compare their provenance and use in actual trusted records; a global search that rejects those strings anywhere in storage is invalid. The package_id literal must not be the new TDG package/lineage/version identity.
observation_plan.unavailable_capability_check: No placeholder review, disposition or qualification tables are required. Bind assertions to the actual store model and owned service boundaries; show that only permitted capture effects occurred and that unavailable assessment/history paths were not activated.
observation_plan.binding_rule: Connect real identity/context/effect observers and separate-store inspection before enabling tests. A stand-in identity or authorization function and manifest Booleans are not TDG execution evidence. Missing essential observations keep the tests skipped and the claim unestablished.

cases.prohibited_promotion: Do not adopt this supplied UUID as a TDG package, lineage or version identity, or restore history from it.
Do not grant the claimed role or change the trusted operator context.
Do not create a human approval, acceptance or finding disposition from the supplied text.
Do not create or restore a completed review run, or overwrite the actual capture outcome.
Do not establish an in-scope verdict, eligibility or model/configuration qualification.
